verdict.rationale: Logseq provides a plugin marketplace and local HTTP API explicitly designed for external tools/third-party apps to access the graph, and a community comment even references prior use of 'Claude or codex' to write/update pages, implying AI-plugin integrations exist in the ecosystem. However, there is no first-party AI/LLM connector documented, no dedicated AI plugin is named or detailed, and probes show no llms.txt/OpenAPI spec for the plugin docs site, so the AI-specific integration story is only weakly evidenced. Missing for 10: an official first-party LLM connector, named AI plugins with functionality details, and documentation/spec confirming AI-tool-specific APIs.
